source_context: Bulk sandbox historical replay evidence pilot. Synthetic seed evidence for attribution-learning pipeline testing; not production evidence.
evidence_items: Singapore chemicals output in 2020 was affected by chemical demand, petrochemical demand, and weaker regional industrial activity.
Basic chemicals and specialty chemicals production reflected shifts in downstream manufacturing demand.
Feedstock prices and naphtha prices influenced chemical production economics.
Chemical plant utilisation and petrochemical plant operations shaped output patterns.
